subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• Elena Ferrante is an Italian novelist.
• In 2011, she published My Brilliant Friend, a novel about friendship and rivalry.
• The novel explores themes of identity and ambition in working-class Naples.
• In 2012, she published The Story of a New Name, a novel about personal transformation.
• The novel explores themes of identity and ambition in post-war Italy.
prompt: The student wants to emphasize a similarity between the two novels by Elena Ferrante. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: Elena Ferrante's novels My Brilliant Friend and The Story of a New Name both explore themes of identity and ambition.
choices.B: Elena Ferrante's novel My Brilliant Friend, which explores themes of identity and ambition, was published one year before The Story of a New Name.
choices.C: My Brilliant Friend was published in 2011, and The Story of a New Name was published in 2012.
choices.D: Unlike The Story of a New Name, Elena Ferrante's novel My Brilliant Friend focuses specifically on working-class Naples.

explanation:
Choice A is the best answer. The sentence uses "both" to emphasize a thematic similarity between Ferrante's two novels, noting that both My Brilliant Friend and The Story of a New Name explore themes of identity and ambition.

Why D is incorrect:

Choice D is incorrect. The sentence uses "unlike" to emphasize a difference between My Brilliant Friend and The Story of a New Name; it doesn't emphasize a similarity between the two novels.
